summary: Routed-datapath LVS was refused by klt before a compare: with the escaped-module-name refusal fixed upstream (klayout-tools#4812), the gate-level-verilog reader now refuses on pin-name case (Liberty RESETN/SETN vs CDL RESETn/SETn). request_notes: Same request as r3, reused unchanged. pdk_root and pin_order_files point at the pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree (archive sha256 ac7e950c4d0394a829658b6e219fea4a4b0c61a998183d5520f8b9e38c6efff2, unpacked in /tmp scratch, not committed). pin_order_files names asap7sc7p5t_rvt/netlist/asap7sc7p5t_28_R.cdl because reference.library looks for spice/ or cdl/ directories that this tree does not have.
